CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

May 28, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 6:59 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra
  City Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Absent:
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN

Staff Present:
ERIC D. MARTINEZ

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: May 14, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the May, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Ng makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  1
 D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  2568 West Commonwealth Avenue, DRB-2024-0001

  •  Request: This is an application for a re-design of two (2) existing 120 SF trash
  enclosures located in the rear parking lot of commercial businesses known as
  Pet Smart and Big Lots, which are both visible from South Fremont Ave.
  •  Applicant: Johnathan Fan
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  1315 West Commonwealth Avenue, DRB-2024-00041

  •  Request: This is an application for exterior remodel to the existing detached 3-
  car garage on an existing 3-unit site that includes a new stucco wall finish.
  •  Applicant: Derek Lee
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:17 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on June 11, 2024.

  2
 MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:17 P.M.
  •  The second was by Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
